lines.text: Many learners say: I go to office every day.
Better: I go to the office every day.
The office! He goes to the office.

data.wrong: I go to office every day.
data.right: I go to the office every day.

native.tip: हिंदी में “ऑफ़िस जाता हूँ” बिना किसी छोटे शब्द के चलता है, पर अंग्रेज़ी में office के पहले the लगाएँ।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I go to office every day.” 😅 सही रूप है “I go to the office every day.” क्योंकि office के पहले the लगता है। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “the office”। इसे ज़ोर से बोलकर दोहराइए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners skip the before office, but English needs it.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I go to office every day.” 😅 The right way is “I go to the office every day.” This is right because office needs the. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
